C0470.title: Former Employee Detained for Stealing 370,000 Mall Points and Cashing Out
C0470.summary: In March 2022, Shangguan News and China Youth Daily's client reported a points theft case in Shanghai's Jing'an District. From November 24, 2021 to February 13, 2022, former employee Diao repeatedly entered the mall, logged into the backend system, and inflated about 369,000 points. He redeemed goods and coupons and resold them online for more than RMB 33,000, causing the mall losses of about RMB 36,000. Diao was criminally detained on suspicion of theft.
